newsitem.title: USA: PCX to list options on three stocks May 12.
newsitem.headline: PCX to list options on three stocks May 12.

text.p: The Pacific Stock Exchange (PCX) said Monday it will list options on Circuit City Stores Inc-CarMax Group, PRI Automation Inc and Vail Resorts Inc May 12.

Circuit City options will have expiries in June, July, October and January and initial strike prices at 12-1/2, 15 and 17-1/2. Position and exercise limits were set at 7,500 contracts. The option will trade in the USAir Group crowd.
PRI Automation options will have expiration months of June, July, August and November with strike prices at 25, 30 and 35. Position and exercise limits will be 10,500 contracts.
PRI Automation options were allocated to a lead market maker with Omega Options.

Vail Resorts options will open with expiries in June, July, September and December and strike prices at 17-1/2, 20 and 22-1/2. Position and exercise limits were set at 7,500 contracts. The options were allocated to lead market makers at Susquehanna Investment Group, the PCX said. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750)) E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
